facts.business: Gala Global Products Limited operates in the stationery, educational products, and printing space, offering school and office stationery, educational products, and digital and offset printing services.

auditor.name: R. B. Gohil & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Advances to suppliers sub-judice with unquantified ECL provisioning; 2) Ind AS adjustments not effected in books; 3) Related party transactions with directors not verified at arm's length, potential Section 185 violation; 4) Expected credit loss not measured per Ind AS 109; 5) Operating segments not reported per Ind AS 108; 6) Intangible assets worth Rs. 13 crore not amortized; 7) Default on unsecured loans; 8) Payments made by directors without adequate audit trail; 9) Irregular TDS deposits. Material uncertainty relating to going concern due to EGM resolution for PPIRP/CIRP. Emphasis on non-compliance with Ind AS 19 (Employee Benefits) and cost record maintenance requirements.

key_risks: Raw Material Price Volatility (paper, ink, plastics)
facts.related_party_note: During the year the company had made various transactions with director/s and other related parties. Auditor unable to verify whether such transactions were carried out at arm's length price. Company running current account with Director/s and Section 185 may be attracted. Payments relating to business operations made directly by Director on behalf of Company without adequate supporting agreements, confirmations and complete audit trail.
